impl Carrier::new.signature: pub fn new( c0_dim: usize, c1_dim: usize, c2_dim: usize, d0: BasicMatrix<Q>, d1: BasicMatrix<Q>, weights: Vec<Q>, provenance: TheoremProvenance, ) -> Result<Self, HomologicalError>
impl Carrier::new.body: { super::exact_scalar::admit_coefficients(&weights)?; // Check weight dimensions if weights.len() != c1_dim { return Err(HomologicalError::WeightDimensionMismatch { expected: c1_dim, got: weights.len(), }); } // Check weight positivity for (i, w) in weights.iter().enumerate() { if *w <= Q::zero() { return Err(HomologicalError::NonPositiveWeight { index: i }); } } // Construct cochain complex (verifies d1*d0=0 and dimensions) let complex = CochainComplex::new(c0_dim, c1_dim, c2_dim, d0, d1, provenance)?; let certificate_d0 = certify_rank(&complex.d0.matrix)?; let rank_d0 = certificate_d0.rank(); let certificate_d1 = certify_rank(&complex.d1.matrix)?; let rank_d1 = certificate_d1.rank(); let kernel = c1_dim .checked_sub(rank_d1) .ok_or(HomologicalError::HomologyDimensionUnderflow { ker_dim: c1_dim, im_dim: rank_d1, })?; if rank_d0 > kernel { return Err(HomologicalError::HomologyDimensionUnderflow { ker_dim: kernel, im_dim: rank_d0, }); } Ok(Self { complex, weights, ranks: (certificate_d0, certificate_d1), }) }
